desc:
🏎️ Build your own racing team from nothing and lead it to the front of the grid! 🏆

🏁 Create your team with your own name and colors, then run it from the pit wall as the team boss. Choose your two drivers, pick their tyres, tell them when to push and watch every race live, with crash replays and podium celebrations! 🎬

🃏 Open driver packs and sign drivers from common to legendary
📦 Open part crates and fit faster bodies, front wings and spoilers in your garage
💪 Train your drivers to raise their stats and unlock their potential
🌍 Race live against teams from every server on 8 circuits, in sun and rain
💰 Score points to earn money, land sponsors and climb from Rookie to Legend
🔧 Upgrade your pit crew, tyre engineers and power unit
🤝 Buy and sell drivers and parts with everyone on the community market
👀 Watch live races from the lobby

🔥 Every team starts at the back of the grid. Will yours become a legend? 🔥

🎁 Codes: RELEASE, PITSTOP, LIGHTSOUT
